response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord tr ON a.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), s AS (SELECT tradekind, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c), g AS (SELECT tradekind, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT tradekind, cnt AS transaction_count, share, share - avg_share AS share_minus_avg FROM g WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY share DESC

assumptions.assumption: Inner joins with SQLite's default case-sensitive '=' implement the exact text matches. Unmatched behaviour records are dropped. A NULL tradekind forms its own group because GROUP BY puts NULLs together.
The average is the plain mean of the per-type shares across the groups present. If there are no groups, the average is NULL and no rows are returned.
